description: Three parameter sets of a jet nozzle used by the propulsor gates. The numbers are arbitrary test values chosen for the checks (not any craft's): they differ from the shared repository's plugin defaults so a hidden default cannot pass a test, the limits are asymmetric in 'biased' so the normalised-angle mapping is exercised on both sides, and 'trimmed' / 'biased' carry a trim angle and a yaw bias. Names are this library's part parameters; the generator maps position -> location and nozzle_velocity -> nozzle_velocity_radpersec for the shared repository's plugin.
